body: For the Mac's hall9k project orchestrator, from Brian via the Windows window at 2026-09-24 16:48 EDT: please ask Brian whether he wants to walk the Mac node's model settings the way the Windows node just did. What happened here today: h9k config show reviewed role by role; default-model moved from claude-opus-5[1m] to claude-opus-5-5[1m] (build and fix follow it); model (refinement) cleared to default so it follows default-model; publication left on claude-sonnet-5 until cards come out wrong; review stays claude-fable-5-1, review-verify and synthesis stay claude-sonnet-5; daemon restarted at a lull to bind it. Also relevant: Opus 5.5 defaults to medium effort and a headless session ignores the owner's user-level effortLevel, so effort stays medium until card 8a56f013 (#583, placed on the Mac) ships the --effort knob. Brian's account on the Mac is a personal Max plan rather than the corporate account this node uses, so the cost question may land differently there; he is asking about that separately.
